snippet.title: Becrowned - Official Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Learn about the story, get a peek at gameplay, and check out the nightmarish world of Becrowned in this trailer for the upcoming surreal survival horror adventure game. Becrowned features a mixture of traditional survival horror gameplay with unique narrative direction and in-game cinematography. You follow Richard Torrance, a man of rational and unbreakable character who has lived his life in the shadow of his goals and desires in Becrowned. Explore locations filled with secrets. Solve puzzles, manage your resources wisely, and avoid unnecessary fights. Who knows what terrible creature might be lurking around the next corner... Becrowned will be available on PC.
